description.value: Lake Wood (Lakewood) is one of several rustic cabins at Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort, a historic 4-season resort established in 1904 on Knouff Lake, about 45 minutes from Kamloops. The small cabin sleeps up to 4 and features a cast iron wood cook stove, propane heater, full-size fridge, and electric cook-top, with a shared bathhouse a short walk away. The resort is remote, accessed via 14.6 km of dirt road, and caters primarily to fishing, boating, and outdoor recreation enthusiasts.

address.value: 9608 Knouff Lake Road, Heffley Creek, British Columbia V0E 1Z1, Canada
